title: Udhayanidhi Stalin detained from Chennai home over 'vulgar' remarks case
content: Udhayanidhi Stalin faced detention after a case was registered against him. He had allegedly made objectionable remarks during a rally on the Cauvery dispute. The controversy erupted after a DMK rally in Thanjavur on Monday. Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam filed a complaint and approached the National Commission for Women. This dispute has shifted political focus away from the Cauvery issue.

title: Stalker uses husband's name to lure teacher, stabs her 20 times in Faridabad
content: In a harrowing incident in Faridabad, a young teacher was brutally murdered by a stalker who deceived her into meeting him at the school gate by using her husband's name. The attacker stabbed her repeatedly, exceeding twenty times, in front of both students and staff. Authorities apprehended the 21-year-old assailant within hours. The victim, a mother of two, had previously warned the stalker about impending legal action.

title: Will next resignation of Iran Prez be accepted? Report claims 'ultimatum' by Khamenei
content: Israeli media reports suggest Iran's Supreme Leader issued an ultimatum to President Pezeshkian regarding resignation.  The report claims the IRGC commander now holds greater influence over strategic decisions.  US President Trump stated Iran has a "last chance" to reach an agreement.  Diplomatic efforts are continuing through mediators despite public denials of talks.  Regional allies urged the US to pursue diplomacy after a planned military strike pause.

title: From borrowing spikes to India call-up: Auqib Nabi replaces Bumrah in Test squad
content: Jammu and Kashmir bowler Auqib Nabi received his first India Test call-up. He replaces the injured Jasprit Bumrah for the Sri Lanka series. Nabi has been a consistent performer in domestic cricket for years. His impressive Ranji Trophy and India A performances earned him this opportunity. This selection recognises outstanding domestic cricket achievements.

title: 'Likely to mislead': FSSAI bars Dabur from selling products with '100%' guarantee claims

The FSSAI stated these labels are ambiguous and unverifiable for consumers. Dabur India is now reviewing the notice issued by the food regulator. This action is part of a broader crackdown on deceptive food labelling.

title: In MP village, kids risk lives every day, hop over dam pillars to reach school

This dangerous route avoids a much longer road trip to the nearest secondary facility. Parents face difficult choices between safety and education for their children. Authorities have been informed and are seeking a swift resolution.

title: Karnataka cabinet expansion: DKS inducts 19 - no Brahmin minister, SCs get 7 berths

The new ministry includes seven SC ministers, a record, and no Brahmin representation for the first time. Several senior leaders were notably excluded from the ministerial positions. A last-minute change saw S S Mallikarjun replace Mankal Vaidya on the list.

title: Brazil game can't mask Indian football's crisis: Bhutia says 'timing is a problem'

title: Lauren Sanchez worked at waterpark; 40 years later, she takes luxurious ocean trips

The Bezos Earth Fund supports significant conservation projects in the Galápagos Marine Reserve. This funding protects vital habitats and migration routes for numerous marine species. title: Udhayanidhi moves HC for anticipatory bail after TVK complaint over 'vulgar' remark

title: France’s billion-tree programme loses funding after court ruling

This ruling halts financial support for planting one billion trees over ten years.  The government must now create a new legal framework with public input.  Future funding will focus on restoring damaged forests and promoting diverse tree species.

The first phase of this development is scheduled for completion by the year 2029. India's National Buildings Construction Corporation will manage the entire project's planning and implementation. This initiative is part of a larger economic package and development partnership between the two nations.

title: Goodbye Ohio, hello Virginia: US navy's next-gen submarines to carry 40 Tomahawks
content: The US Navy is set to reclassify its future Virginia-class submarines as guided missile submarines, reflecting the substantial strike capabilities provided by the Virginia Payload Module. This innovative upgrade will succeed the aging Ohio-class submarines, with the new design allowing for a remarkable expansion in missile capacity and payload variety. Ultimately, the Navy aims to incorporate nineteen of these advanced submarines into its fleet.

title: How AI agents will rewrite the way we use next‑generation smartphones
content: Smartphones are set to abandon their traditional app icon grids in favor of AI-driven interfaces. Instead of manually opening apps, users will communicate their intentions via voice or text to smart agents that handle tasks seamlessly. This groundbreaking shift heralds a new age of technology, where app stores could evolve into dynamic service registries for these advanced AI agents.

title: BSE Sensex trades in green, Nifty50 slips in red: Why benchmark indices moved opposite?
content: Indian stock market indices Nifty50 and BSE Sensex diverged due to a new closing auction session. This new mechanism replaced the volume-weighted average price for price discovery. The exchange clarified that this divergence was not an anomaly but a result of the new process. The closing price is now determined by an equilibrium price mechanism which maximizes trading volume. Market participants showed encouraging participation in the inaugural closing auction session.

title: 1.28 lakh people in seven Assam districts reel under floods; toll rises to 87 with two more deaths

title: Amid a flood of holiday demands, Collectors weather an online storm
content: As online demands and criticism over rain holidays mount, District Collectors say decisions are guided by weather data and field reports—not social media pressure; school closures during orange, yellow alerts depend on local assessments, they say

title: Rain eases, but swollen rivers keep flood-prone areas in Ernakulam district on alert
content: Following heavy downpours over the past few days, 110 people across the district took shelter in relief camps, with eight camps remaining active on Monday and four others closed

title: Prashant Kishor breaches BJP’s fortress in Bankipur
